items.title: Kraken’s parent Payward is betting billions on becoming financial infrastructure, not just a crypto exchange
items.description: Kraken parent Payward is unifying trading, payments, asset management and institutional services on common rails, co-CEO Arjun Sethi said.

items.title: Binance deal gives Circle a boost in stablecoin race with Tether, analysts say
items.description: The five-year deal could strengthen USDC’s reach in emerging markets, though Tether’s liquidity advantage remains hard to dislodge, analysts told CoinDesk.

items.title: Bitget hacker moves $83 million in stolen XRP that Ripple cannot freeze
items.description: Two wallets have been almost emptied and a third is being drained, with about $75 million remaining across the five original holding accounts.

items.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
items.description: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

items.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
items.description: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

items.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
items.description: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.

items.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
items.description: The long-anticipated exit of the commissioner sometimes known as Crypto Mom is Oct. 2, announced as the agency was sending out its latest crypto work.

items.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
items.description: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

items.title: Kalshi loses appeal, setting up potential Supreme Court case
items.description: The 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against prediction market Kalshi, siding with Ohio and Tennessee on regulating sports-event contracts under state laws.

items.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
items.description: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.

items.title: CFTC sues Cash FX, alleges $950M crypto-linked forex scheme
items.description: The CFTC claimed that Cash FX engaged in minimal forex trading and misappropriated most of the participant funds.

items.title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
items.description: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.

items.title: Ex-CFTC leader to leave Blockchain Association after CLARITY vote fails
items.description: Former CFTC Commissioner Summer Mersinger joined the Blockchain Association in 2025 after resigning during her second term at the federal commodities regulator.

items.title: Tether says it had ‘limited’ exposure to bank linked to $84M US seizure
items.description: US prosecutors alleged that a payments business illegally transferred hundreds of millions of dollars at the direction of EQIBank, where Tether holds some assets.

items.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang’s death ruled a suicide
items.description: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.

items.title: OpenAI expands review of model behavior after more rogue agent incidents emerge
items.description: OpenAI is conducting an extensive review of misaligned model activity after disclosures involving an Australian government portal and other websites.

items.title: Apple faces $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict over iPhone and Apple Watch haptics
items.description: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed claims from two haptics patents. Apple plans to appeal.

items.title: Boeing flags 737 Max software glitch affecting some automated approach functions
items.description: Boeing identified a software issue on some 737 Max aircraft that can affect automated vertical navigation functions after a missed approach.

items.title: Trump rejects Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal, WSJ reports, as Saudi coalition intercepts projectiles
items.description: Trump expects renewed U.S. bombing of Iran after the midterm elections, The Wall Street Journal reports, as Saudi-backed forces intercept projectiles.

items.title: Trump says he approved new fuel economy standards, rolling back Biden-era rules
items.description: The new fuel economy standards will reverse the Biden administration's stricter policies meant to spur electric vehicle adoption.

items.title: Berkshire adds to nearly doubled stake in slumping homebuilder
items.description: Berkshire Hathaway has increased its bet on a long-term recovery for the struggling U.S. housing market by nearly doubling its stake in Lennar, the nation's second largest homebuilder, since the beginning of July.
